option_name: Logan River connection via Wyaralong Dam
notes: Different kind of entry than the other two future options: this project is already underway, not a hypothetical future commit decision - the South West Pipeline segment was completed in 2024, and Seqwater's own modelling states the Wyaralong Water Treatment Plant (the remaining piece connecting Wyaralong Dam itself to the Grid) 'is likely to be needed around 2031,' with contractors already shortlisted (see the statements.qld.gov.au/statements/99307 source for that). Lead time of 5 years is this project's own estimate (2031 target minus 2026, the as_at_date) rather than a figure Seqwater states as a duration directly - flagged as such, not presented with the same confidence as a quoted figure. Yield: Seqwater's own Feb 2025 'Proposed Wyaralong Water Treatment Plant Project Overview' states 'the plant would be capable of producing 120 million litres of drinking water a day, expandable to 150 million litres per day in the future' - 120 ML/day x 365 / 1000 = 43.8 GL/yr used here (the plant's stated initial capability, not the future-expandable figure).
